name: Informal proof by contradiction
definition: Assume the thing you doubt is true, follow it honestly, and arrive at something that cannot be. That rules the assumption out. In a multiple-choice contest it is usually used to knock out choices rather than to write a proof.
recognizeWhen: show that no such number exists
prove that it cannot be done
suppose there were such an arrangement
misconceptions: I found no example and concluded none exists, without any argument.
I reached a contradiction but from an extra assumption I had quietly added.
I proved the opposite of what I assumed and thought I was finished.
